# Notices for the corpus slice

`corpus.md` holds paragraphs copied from the documentation files below, to
serve as test input for the part-of-speech tagger. The paragraphs are
unmodified except that they were selected from their files, and soft line
breaks are kept as they were. Each project keeps its copyright; the
licence terms follow. Source links point at the project's default branch
as of 2026-11-14; the commit was not recorded.
